purpose: Teach: ランナー/協奏曲/イエロー/ベリー/タラ/兎/フェリー/ランニング

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、運動会で、ぼく、リレーランナーに、選ばれたよ!
lines.en: Mom! I got chosen as a relay runner for sports day!
lines.style: Bright, energetic rush on the opening. Voice climbs with pride. Quick delivery, bursting to share the news. Real joy — not performed, urgent to be heard.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お父さんの好きなピアノ協奏曲、お休みの日、聴いてたわね。
lines.en: That's wonderful. You've been working so hard on that.
lines.style: Warm, gentle affirmation. Soft smile in the voice. Slower pace — giving weight to what he's accomplished. The steadiness of a parent who sees him clearly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 信号のイエロー、止まる準備、するんだよね、ママ、教えてくれた。
lines.en: Just like you taught me — when the light turns yellow, I need to be ready to stop.
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful articulation. Quiet pride in showing he understood. Slight hesitation before 'stop' — checking that he got it right. The earnestness of a child wanting approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 夏のフルーツ、ベリー系、ヨーグルトに入れて、食べましょうね。
lines.en: We should get some berries this summer and add them to yogurt.
lines.style: Gentle pivot, as if thinking aloud. Warm, present tone. Light and easy — the kind of casual planning that grounds him. Not forced, just noticing the seasons together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんが、タラの煮物、作ってくれるって、嬉しい!
lines.en: I'm so happy Grandma is making cod stew for us.
lines.style: Soft excitement, genuine gratitude underneath. Not loud, but warm. The particular joy of knowing something he loves is coming. A small smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 絵本の兎さん、翔くん、大好きよね、いつも読んでるね。
lines.en: You do love that rabbit in your picture book — you read it all the time.
lines.style: Tender observation, noticing him. Soft, affectionate tone. A parent delighting in what her child cares about. Slight warmth on 'rabbit' — she's smiling at the memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夏休み、お祖父ちゃんちまで、フェリーで、行きたいな、ママ!
lines.en: You'd like to take the ferry to Grandpa's house for summer break, wouldn't you?
lines.style: Warm, indulgent. Slight rise in tone on 'ferry' — she's already imagining it with him. Gentle encouragement, letting him dream. The 'wouldn't you' is soft, inviting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 毎朝のランニング、お父さん、続けてるね、健康のためにね。
lines.en: Your father keeps up with his morning runs. He's committed to staying healthy.
lines.style: Soft admiration, quiet observation. Gentle, reflective pace. A moment of noticing something good about him. Trailing warmth at the end — pride in someone she loves, spoken softly.
